found: Coursed limestone ashlar on the recipe's own 8 courses of 4 blocks in half bond, with the joints and arrises where the structure puts them. The model has invented ROCK FACED blocks: several courses carry deep rusticated projections with their own shading, which the recipe does not paint and the height map does not carry (its faces are 6 mm with slight waviness). Baked into a base colour map, that shading will contradict the geometry under any lighting. Small pebbles and shells scattered on the faces. No lettering, numeral, logo, badge, signature, watermark or mason's mark anywhere in the four crops, and nothing that reads as a particular real building.
statement: Every texel of every map is inside exactly one of these crops, each written at 1:1 with no resampling, and each was looked at before this set was offered for publication.
suspected: In the crop at 512,0, on a block face, there are faint shapes that may be characters, something like a 4 and a 2 with others beside them, degraded and ambiguous at 1:1 and at five times magnification. I cannot tell whether they are lettering or weathering, and I am not deciding it. The operator decides; this output is not offered either way.
